assignments.reason: Breaking one's heart (משבר את לבו) is a paraphrase of the longer node 'כשמשבר את רוחו בקרבו...' already in Package 1. Its essential nature is the inward act of self-breaking that constitutes the עולה — the same spiritual reality as רוח נשברה and the other nodes in Package 1. The source text states: 'וְהַשֵּׁם חֲתַ"ךְ נַעֲשֶׂה עַל יְדֵי שֶׁמְּשַׁבֵּר אֶת לִבּוֹ' — the Name חת"ך is made through breaking one's heart. While the eitza edge (2958) captures the causal flow from this act to שם חת"ך, the act itself belongs by essential nature to the domain of broken spirit and burnt offering.
